import numpy as np

    alpha = np.array([[0.2, 0.4], [0.8, 0.6]])
    pc = cp.constraints.PowConeND(W, hypos, alpha, axis=1)
    probe("Same 3-variable problem but W=cp.bmat([[x[0],x[2]],[x[1],1.0]]) with alpha=np.array([[0.2,0.4],[0.8,0.6]]) used as-is, PowConeND(W,hypos,alpha,axis=1) (W and alpha left untransposed for axis=1 case of test_pow_cone_nd_3d).", pc)
